people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

people.name: Susa
people.line: Capital city of the Persian Empire

translations.web: There was a certain Jew in the citadel of Susa, whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite,
translations.bsb: Now there was at the citadel of Susa a Jewish man from the tribe of Benjamin named Mordecai son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish.
